title: crepidomanes subclathratum

It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crepidomanes subclathratum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
